library_enrichment.summary: Closed-chain serratus and scapular-control drill adding a controlled plus phase at the top of a push-up position.
coaching_cues: Hold a straight line from head to heels or use an incline.
Push the floor away at the top without rounding the low back.
Let the shoulder blades come together slightly before the next plus.
common_errors: Bending elbows during the plus phase.
Sagging hips to create shoulder movement.
use_when: Serratus strength and closed-chain shoulder control are priorities.
Pressing warm-ups need a scapular component.
The athlete tolerates a plank or incline plank.
avoid_when: Wrist loading or plank position is painful.
Scapular protraction causes shoulder symptoms.

main_work.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
main_work.purpose: Build horizontal pressing strength with natural arm path and shoulder control

library_enrichment.summary: Free-weight horizontal press that allows each arm to move independently and challenges shoulder control more than a barbell.
coaching_cues: Set the dumbbells over the elbows before the first rep.
Lower until upper arms are controlled below or near torso level.
Press without letting the dumbbells collide at the top.
common_errors: Dropping too deep and losing shoulder position.
Letting one dumbbell drift ahead of the other.
Failing to control the setup and exit from the bench.
use_when: A press is needed with more natural arm path than a barbell.
Hypertrophy work calls for a larger usable range.
avoid_when: Current chest, shoulder, elbow, or wrist pain that worsens with pressing.
Inability to control the bottom position without compensation.
The athlete cannot safely get dumbbells into position.

main_work.purpose: Vertical pressing with stable path to build overhead shoulder capacity

source_refs.section_title: ACSM Progression Models in Resistance Training for Healthy Adults
source_refs.heading: Machine Shoulder Press

library_enrichment.summary: Guided overhead press option that lowers stabilization demand and supports simple progressive shoulder loading.
coaching_cues: Adjust the seat so handles begin near shoulder height.
Keep the back and head supported as designed.
Press smoothly without locking out violently.
common_errors: Starting too low for available shoulder range.
Using a machine path that does not fit the athlete.
use_when: A low-complexity vertical press is needed.
Hypertrophy volume should avoid excessive trunk fatigue.
Beginners need a stable overhead pattern.
avoid_when: The fixed path causes shoulder pinching.
The athlete lacks pain-free overhead range even on the machine.

main_work.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
main_work.purpose: Lateral deltoid hypertrophy for balanced shoulder development

library_enrichment.summary: Simple shoulder accessory for lateral deltoid development and balanced shoulder hypertrophy.
coaching_cues: Stand tall with a slight elbow bend.
Raise arms out and slightly forward in the scapular plane.
Stop around shoulder height unless higher range is controlled.
common_errors: Swinging the torso to lift the weights.
Leading with the hands too high and irritating the shoulder.
Shrugging before the delts initiate the lift.
use_when: Lateral deltoid hypertrophy is a priority.
Pressing volume alone is not enough for shoulder size.
avoid_when: Abduction range causes shoulder pain.
The athlete cannot control neck tension even with light load.
